node.statement: Assembly of the budget. Adding the actor-hull/collinearity contribution and the exterior sign-union contribution over the mass split of an admissible row yields an explicit absolute constant C such that sum_j P_{ij}·x_j ≤ C·tau for every admissible row i. This is exactly the transverse-moment budget claimed: the attainable D-direction moment is O(tau), realized as the exact Farkas/dual certificate assembled from the mass-one constraint, the actor coordinates and collinearity, and the aggregated negative-mass budget.
